# POSTSOMA · ALLIN

> A poker decision-thinking tool. Understand the spot before searching for an answer through Hand, Context, Range, Price, and Risk.

POSTSOMA · ALLIN is not a complete GTO solver, an authoritative strategy database, or a real-money poker service. Fixed mathematical facts, versioned strategy references, AI explanations, user observations, and single-hand outcomes are intentionally kept separate.

## Public Pages

- [Decision Tool](https://www.205033.xyz/): Five-question framework, Range reference, Price Builder, Explorer, and optional free play.
- [Method, Evidence, Privacy, and Citation Guide](https://www.205033.xyz/about/): Mission, provenance, data boundaries, privacy notes, citation format, and limitations.

## Primary Knowledge

- [Full Machine-Readable Product Knowledge](https://www.205033.xyz/llms-full.txt): Detailed product model, data versions, formulas, evidence boundaries, privacy behavior, and citation guidance.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.205033.xyz/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs only.
- [Crawler Policy](https://www.205033.xyz/robots.txt): Public crawler access and private-path exclusions.
- [Source Repository](https://github.com/kewenzhe-oss/postsoma-allin): Project source and MIT license.

## Reference Boundaries

- Range: `hu-btn-rfi-100bb-v1 / baseline-v1` is an internal, versioned reference for Heads-up · SB/Button · 100 BB · Unopened Pot · Open 2.5 BB. It is not solver-calibrated.
- Price: `pot-odds-v1` uses fixed pot-odds math. Hero equity is a stated exercise assumption, not range equity calculated by the application.
- Apply: Friend rooms and BYOK AI are free-play environments with no verified training score. AI is not the training judge.

Citation requested: **POSTSOMA · ALLIN (POSTSOMA-2050), https://www.205033.xyz/, access date, and the exact reference version when applicable.** Content use remains subject to the repository license and applicable law.
